_note: Page-plan contract for paper2deck. Fill one object per slide; run.py adopts plan.json automatically when it sits next to case.json. See references/slide-blueprint.md for the rules.

deck.title: <paper title, or the deck's own title>
deck.footer: <optional footer text; defaults to the deck title>

storyline.gap: <one sentence: what prior work left open; may be empty only if declared>
storyline.evidence: <one sentence: which artefact carries the load>

_accepted_note: warning codes an author explicitly accepts on the record, e.g. ["BULLET_IS_PROSE"]

slides.title: <<=48 CJK / <=88 latin characters>
slides.claim: <the single assertion of this page, <=140 chars>
numbers: <value with unit/metric as shown to the audience>
